§11:459-465 (the lines are 459-465 of the markdown file). Content:
"Each item accepts the ordinary PATCH fields `table_id`, `starts_at_local`, `party_size`; omitted fields retain their current values and unknown fields are ignored. So the all-or-nothing semantics: an overlap among *resulting* bookings (after applying the batch) → 409, and presumably nothing happens (all-or-nothing). Also "Unchanged listed bookings retain their occupancy."

Resulting bookings don't overlap (each in the other's original slot which is now free once the other moves). But a naive implementation checks each move against the *current* occupancy: moving A→t_3 conflicts with B currently at t_3 → 409. So conflict-free swap refused.

```
import subprocess
d = subprocess.run(["git","diff","--","stage-4/app/main.py"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
lines = d.splitlines(keepends=False)
# find header (until first @@)
out = []
i=0
while i < len(lines) and not lines[i].startswith("@@"):
    out.append(lines[i]); i+=1
hunks=[]
cur=[]
for ln in lines[i:]:
    if ln.startswith("@@"):
        if cur: hunks.append(cur)
        cur=[ln]
    else:
        cur.append(ln)
if cur: hunks.append(cur)
for h in hunks:
    header = h[0]
    # parse old start
    import re
    m = re.match(r"@@ -(\d+)", header)
    oldstart = int(m.group(1))
    if oldstart >= 2500:
        out.extend(h)
open(r"...\ui.patch","w",newline="\n").write("\n".join(out)+"\n")
```
